name: @dina/ucp
description: Dina's UCP (Universal Commerce Protocol, v2026-08-25) buyer-side contract: profiles, version choice, authority binding, capability intersection, RFC 8941/9421 HTTP message signatures, money and units, catalogue/cart/checkout/order readers and request builders, the checkout intent, permalinks, MCP and REST envelopes, and the hosted-profile publication envelope. Pure and runtime-neutral; crypto is injected (docs/UCP_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md).
